==English== ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/pɛn/|[ˈpʰɛn]|a=RP,GA,CA,Scotland,Wales,Ireland}} ** {{audio|en|En-us-pen.ogg|a=GA}} ** {{audio|en|En-us-inlandnorth-pen.ogg|a=US,Inland North}} * {{IPA|en|/pɪn/|[ˈpʰɪ̟n]|a=US,pin-pen}} * {{IPA|en|/pen/|[ˈpʰen]|~|[ˈpʰe̞n]|a=AU}} * {{IPA|en|/pen/|[ˈpʰe̝n]|~|[ˈpʰɪn]|a=NZ}} * {{rhymes|en|ɛn|s=1}} * {{hyph|en|pen}} * {{hmp|en|pin|aa1=pin-pen}} ===Etymology 1=== {{etymid|en|pen-enlosure-nailed-pinned}} {{wp|+ (enclosure)}} From {{inh|en|enm|pen}}, {{m|enm|penne|t=enclosure for animals}}, from {{inh|en|ang|penn|t=enclosure, fold, pen}}, from {{inh|en|gem-pro|*pennō}}, {{m|gem-pro|*pannijō|t=pin, bolt, nail, tack}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*bend-|t=pointed peg, nail, edge}}. Related to {{m|en|pin}}. Sense “prison” originally figurative extension to “enclosure for persons” (1845), later influenced by {{m|en|penitentiary|t=prison}}, being analyzed as an abbreviation (1884).{{R:Online Etymology Dictionary}} ====Noun==== {{en-noun}} # {{senseid|en|Q858177}}An [[enclosure]] ([[enclose]]d area) used to contain [[domesticated]] animals, especially [[sheep]] or [[cattle]]. #: {{ux|en|There are two steers in the third '''pen'''.}} # {{lb|en|slang}} A [[penitentiary]], i.e. a state or federal prison for convicted felons. #: {{ux|en|They caught him with a stolen horse, and he wound up in the '''pen''' again.}} #* {{quote-song|en|year=1957|author=w:Stephen Sondheim|title=Gee, Officer Krupke|album=w:West Side Story|text=Officer Krupke, you've done it againǃ / This boy don't need a judge, he needs a year in the '''penǃ''' / It ain't just a question of misunderstood / Deep down inside him, he's no goodǃ}} # {{senseid|en|Q579478}} {{lb|en|baseball}} The [[bullpen#English:_Q579478|bullpen]]. #: {{ux|en|Two righties are up in the '''pen'''.}} =====Derived terms===== {{col3|en |bullpen|Pen Mill|blast pen |cattle pen |crush pen|goose-pen|hogpen|potato pen|shuck pen|cowpen|henpen|impen|penkeeper|penkeeping|pennage|pentrough|pigpen|playpen|unpen }} =====Related terms===== {{col|en|pin}} =====Translations===== {{trans-top|enclosure (enclosed area) for animals}}{{multitrans|data= * Albanian: * Arabic: * Armenian: * Basque: * Belarusian: * Bulgarian: * Catalan: * Chinese: * Czech: * Danish: * Dutch: * Esperanto: * Fataluku: * Finnish: * French: * Galician: * German: * Gothic: * Greek: * Hittite: * Hungarian: * Icelandic: * Ingrian: * Irish: * Italian: * Japanese: * Khmer: * Lao: * Latin: * Macedonian: * Māori: * Norwegian: * Persian: * Polish: * Portuguese: * Romanian: * Russian: {{tt+|ru|заго́н|m}}, {{tt+|ru|коша́ра|f}} {{q|sheepfold}} * Serbo-Croatian: * Slovak: * Spanish: * Swahili: * Swedish: * Tetum: * Thai: * Turkish: * Ukrainian: * Walloon: }} {{trans-bottom}} {{trans-see|penitentiary}} {{trans-see|(baseball) bullpen|bullpen}} ===Etymology 2=== {{etymid|en|pen-enclose-close-lock-bolt}} From {{inh|en|enm|pennen}}, from {{inh|en|ang|*pennian|t=to close, lock, bolt|pos=attested in {{m|ang|onpennian|t=to open}}}}, derived from {{m|ang|penn}} (see above). Akin to {{cog|nds|pennen|t=to secure a door with a bolt}}. ====Verb==== {{en-verb|+|+|+,~t}} # {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[enclose]] in a [[#Noun|pen]]. #* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|book=4|passage=Watching where shepherds '''pen''' their flocks at eve.|year=1873}} =====Derived terms===== {{col|en|pen up|pent|pent-up}} =====Translations===== {{trans-top|to enclose}}{{multitrans|data= * Bulgarian: * Finnish: * German: * Greek: * Italian: * Norwegian: * Portuguese: * Russian: {{tt+|ru|запира́ть|impf}}, {{tt+|ru|запере́ть|pf}}, {{tt+|ru|заключа́ть|impf}}, {{tt+|ru|заключи́ть|pf}} }} {{trans-bottom}} ===Etymology 3=== {{etymid|en|pen-writing_tool-feather-wing}} {{root|en|ine-pro|*peth₂-}} [[Image:Ballpoint-pen-parts.jpg|thumb|right|A [[ballpoint pen]], showing assembly.]] From {{inh|en|enm|penne}}, from {{der|en|xno|penne}}, from {{der|en|fro|penne}}, from {{der|en|la|penna|t=feather}}, from {{der|en|ine-pro|*péth₂r̥|*péth₂r̥ ~ pth₂én-|t=feather, wing}}, from {{m|ine-pro|*peth₂-|t=to rush, fly|pos=whence {{m|en|petition}}}}, {{w|Proto-Indo-European root|root}} of {{m|ine-pro|*petra-}}, whence {{cog|grc|πτερόν|t=wing|pos=whence {{m|en|pterodactyl}}}}, and also of {{cog|sa|पत्रम्|t=wing, feather}}, {{cog|cu|перо|t=pen}}, {{cog|non|fjǫðr|t=feather}}, {{cog|ang|feþer,feðer}} ({{w|Modern English}} {{m|en|feather}}); note the /p/ → /f/ {{w|Grimm's law|Germanic sound change}}. {{doublet|en|panne|penna|pinna}}. See {{m|en|feather}} and {{m|grc|πέτομαι}} for more. Not related to {{m|en|pencil}}. ====Noun==== {{wp}} {{en-noun}} # {{senseid|en|Q165447}} A tool, originally made from a [[feather]] but now usually a small tubular instrument, containing ink used to [[write]] or make marks. #: {{hypo|en|ballpoint pen|ballpoint|ball pen|ballpen|biro|;|dip pen|nib pen|fountain pen|stylographic pen|;|gel pen|;|autopen}} #: {{ux|en|He took notes with a '''pen'''.}} #: {{ux|en|another novel from the '''pen''' of everybody's fave thriller writer.}} #: {{ux|en|Please use a '''pen''', not a pencil, when filling out this form. Use black or blue ink only.}} # {{senseid|en|writer}} {{lb|en|figurative}} A [[writer]], or their {{l|en|style|id=manner}}. #: {{ux|en|He has a sharp '''pen'''.}} #* {{RQ:Fuller Church History|passage=those learned '''pens'''}} # {{senseid|en|ink marks}} {{lb|en|colloquial}} Marks of [[ink]] left by a pen. #: {{ux|en|He's unhappy because he got '''pen''' on his new shirt.}} # A [[light pen]]. # {{senseid|en|cartilage}} {{lb|en|zoology}} The internal [[cartilage]] skeleton of a [[squid]], shaped like a pen. # {{senseid|en|feather}} {{lb|en|now|rare|poetic|dialectal}} A [[feather]], especially one of the flight feathers of a bird, angel etc. #* {{RQ:Spenser Faerie Queene|passage=And eke the '''pennes''', that did his pineons bynd,
Were like mayne-yards, with flying canuas lynd,
With which whenas him liſt the ayre to beat {{...}}}} # {{senseid|en|wing}} {{lb|en|poetic}} A [[wing]]. #* {{RQ:Milton Paradise Lost|passage=but feather'd soon and fledge
They summed their '''pens''', and soaring the air sublime|year=1873}} # {{senseid|en|syringe}} A [[syringe]]-like device for [[inject]]ing a dose of medication such as [[insulin]] or [[epinephrine]]. {{q|See {{w|Injector pen}}.}} #* {{quote-book|en|date=2023-08-29|author=Geri Krotow|title=A Wasp in the Woods|publisher=Tule Publishing|isbn=9781959988724 |text="I'm sure she had more than one EpiPen {{...}}" "But she didn't have one when she got stung or she'd have used it." By all appearances, Mariah died in the woods, {{...}} If she managed to grab the '''pen''' found under her leg from her bag or pocket, she never discharged it. But Crystal doesn't have these details. "Doesn't it make sense that she kept an extra '''pen''' in her cupboard, and one in her bag? The extra '''pen''' fell out, is all."}} # {{senseid|en|electronic cigarette}} {{ellipsis of|en|vapor pen||electronic cigarette}}. #: {{ux|en|a dab '''pen'''; a wax '''pen'''}} =====Derived terms=====
